Name: Epic Pixolotl

Description.name: Epic Pixolotl
Description.description: Even though the Wubbox's history doesn't intersect much with that of Seasonal Monsters, it's still a [sic] admirer from afar of the technical achievement of Seasonal Shanty. While realizing the Epic Pixolotl, the Supernatural designer thought it would pay homage to the lighthouse atop the floating barge, particularly the special gleaming stone sourced from a landmark from the ancient Monster World.

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Pixolotl
